name: executing Tidepool protocol transitions
from: An already-authorized Tidepool admission, enterprise-governance, distribution-vote, cycle-close, reconciliation, or disclosure transition with the witnesses required by its operation contract.
to: The authoritative Tidepool state and append-only receipts reflect the transition, or an explicit refusal preserves prior state.
cost: Bounded protocol execution and receiving evidence; no discretionary principal custody or invented governance state.
otherwise: Refuse without mutation and expose the missing authority, witness, state, quorum, reconciliation, or receiving condition.
